---
title: "Compressing an experiment"
description: "One pass to a compressed dataset whose size does not depend on the rows; the same fit; shards that merge."
order: 2
jupyter: python3
---

The universal model needs only one compressed row per stratum, an arm × cohort: the number of clusters $G_h$, the sum of the cluster summaries $\sum u_a$, and the sum of their outer products $\sum u_a u_a^\top$ (the [conditionally sufficient statistics post](https://jeffwong.github.io/posts/conditionally_sufficient_statistics/)). The cluster summary $u_a$ holds the blocks $(S^Y, S, S^T)$ of the cluster's rows. It is built during the pass and never stored.

```{python}
import numpy as np
import polars as pl

import ume
from ume.testing import simulate_accounts

df = simulate_accounts(20_000, seed=2026)
exp = ume.annotate(
    df,
    cluster="account",
    instrument="Z",
    treatment="T",
    cohort="day",
    covariates=ume.covariates(x1=2.0, x2=2.0, kids=0, device=ume.categorical(reference="tv")),
).metrics(ume.mean("y", name="hours"), ume.ratio("N", "D", name="rebuffers_per_play"))

cd = exp.compress()
cd
```

## A dictionary of sufficient statistics

`cd` is a mapping from strata to compressed rows:

```{python}
row = cd[ume.Stratum(Z=1, cohort=1)]
row
```

Its first moments are the three blocks, summed over the stratum's clusters. $S_{00}$ counts rows, and the indicator columns of a categorical hold counts by level:

```{python}
row.blocks()["S"]
```

## The same fit

Fitting the compressed data gives the fit on the rows, to rounding error:

```{python}
fit_rows, fit_compressed = exp.fit(), cd.fit()
{
    "max |Δβ|": float(np.abs(fit_rows.beta - fit_compressed.beta).max()),
    "max relative |Δ cov|": float(np.abs(fit_rows.cov - fit_compressed.cov).max() / np.abs(fit_rows.cov).max()),
}
```

```{python}
fit_compressed.effects()
```

## Shards

Compressed rows add. Each shard can be compressed separately, on a different machine, and the results summed. A streaming `Compressor` needs the reference points and levels fixed before the pass, so we take them from the design that `compress` resolved:

```{python}
design = cd.design
shards = [
    ume.Compressor(design).update(df.filter(pl.col("account") % 3 == k).sort("account")).finish()
    for k in range(3)
]
merged = shards[0] + shards[1] + shards[2]
float(np.abs(merged.fit().beta - fit_rows.beta).max())
```

Rows of a cluster must not be split across shards. Shuffle by cluster before sharding; a merge that sees the same cluster twice is refused.

## Size

The compressed dataset has the same size for 20,000 or 20 million accounts. It holds `len(cd)` strata with $1 + q + q^2$ numbers each, here:

```{python}
len(cd), cd.q, len(cd) * (1 + cd.q + cd.q**2)
```
